commands.label: relocated_original_RDS
commands.command:
Rscript -e args<-commandArgs(TRUE)
m<-readRDS(args[1]);coef_csv<-read.csv(args[2],check.names=FALSE,fileEncoding="UTF-8-BOM")
stopifnot(all(c("term","estimate") %in% names(coef_csv)),nrow(coef_csv)==33)
h<-read.csv(args[3],check.names=FALSE)
cf<-coef(m);stopifnot(all(coef_csv$term %in% names(cf)))
p<-predict(m,newdata=h,type="response")
cat("R_version=",as.character(getRversion()),"\n",sep="")
cat("reference_age=",m$xlevels$age[1],"\n",sep="")
cat("reference_procedure=",m$xlevels$procedure[1],"\n",sep="")
cat("coefficients=",length(cf),"\n",sep="")
cat("coefficient_csv_max_difference=",format(max(abs(cf[coef_csv$term]-coef_csv$estimate)),digits=17),"\n",sep="")
cat("heldout_probability_max_difference=",format(max(abs(signif(p,12)-h$combined)),digits=17),"\n",sep="")
cat("formula=",paste(deparse(formula(m)),collapse=" "),"\n",sep="")
stopifnot(m$xlevels$age[1]=="Adult",m$xlevels$procedure[1]=="Abdominal aortic aneurysm repair",length(cf)==33,max(abs(cf[coef_csv$term]-coef_csv$estimate))<1e-12,max(abs(signif(p,12)-h$combined))<1e-11)
